_doc: ⚑ S191 — THE RECOMMENDATION, 2003 (Phase 5; PLAN_ROUND5 'from early Internet Explorer to modern Chrome'). After his first daily check-in, a senior member of the programme's forum recommends a thread; the forum opens in the period's browser. Before the board, its RULES page — 'I Agree' the only live answer, the web twin of the rules sheet on the institution's wall. The thread is about coming home from the programme; he can post one fixed line (no free typing), a moderator approves it, and '3 people are praying for you'. GROUNDING (his research SocialMedia_Deep.md §2; intake.md): moderated, confidential forums with membership approval, category rooms by age/sex/marital status, accountability threads, peer prayer, senior members answering newcomers (Living Hope's boards, documented from 1998 — described in 2003 as a 'confidential, free, moderated message board'); the Rules page and 'I Agree' are the research's own proposal [I]. Every mark here is INVENTED (Harbor, WebView, the members).
